verdict.rationale: The docs describe Milvus Lite as a Python library that embeds in your application. You create a local database by passing a file name to `MilvusClient` (e.g. "milvus_demo.db"), and it targets laptops, Jupyter notebooks and edge devices. Milvus Standalone also runs on a single machine via Docker, and both share the same client API as Distributed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Milvus Lite in practice, and full feature parity (Lite covers only "most" features and is documented only as a Python library).
